title: Fix Kit Diagram Hierarchy Line Visibility
summary: Fixed missing hierarchy lines in Kit diagram by addressing a critical bug in row ID parsing where hyphens in GUIDs were causing incorrect kind/guid extraction. Unified parentGuid and folderGuid mappings in buildKitDiagramData to ensure all relationships (Type->Parent, Design->Parent, File->Folder, Folder->Parent) are correctly represented as 'part-of' edges with unique prefixed IDs. This ensures that the diagram correctly reflects the kit hierarchy and maintains visibility even when ancestors are collapsed in the table via orphan prevention logic.
